div.class: border rounded bg-light p-3 mb-3 o_cs_screen_guide
div.p: What is this screen? A list of services that may help this customer, based on current customer data.

ul.li: See which service was suggested, its score, and the reason.
Read the questions you should ask to confirm the need.
Select suitable services and create draft offerings for validation.

div.p: Start here: Read the reason, ask the discovery questions, then select only the services that deserve a customer conversation. A draft is not a sale, a presentation, or a CRM opportunity.

form.div: هذه توصيات للاستكشاف فقط. تحقق من الاحتياج واهتمام العميل قبل تقديم الخدمة أو تأهيل فرصة.

button.name: action_create_drafts
button.help: Create one draft offering for each selected service so the CSM can validate the need with the customer. This does not present a service or create a CRM opportunity.
Close the recommendations without creating drafts. Recommendations are calculated again from current customer evidence the next time this window is opened.
